methods.name: epiAneufinder / pyEpiAneufinder

methods.evidence: Published scATAC; 100 kb bins, downsampled SNU601; py version beta

methods.name: Alleloscope
methods.inputs: SNP allele counts per cell and region, depth counts, candidate regions; matched DNA segmentation recommended for scATAC
methods.outputs: Per-cell major haplotype proportion, relative coverage, allele states and posterior confidence
methods.mechanism: EM phases SNPs across cells and pools SNPs per region; relative depth and allelic proportions
methods.reference_requirements: Not intrinsically reliant on a designated normal; calibration and absolute states require additional assumptions; matched DNA recommended
methods.low_coverage_handling: Pooling increases information but phase errors, mixture and no allele reads limit inference
methods.homozygous_deletion: Not established: neither generic loss nor missing allele observations prove 0:0
methods.evidence: Published scATAC and scDNA; regional events and selected marker regions, not a universal resolution guarantee

methods.name: Numbat
methods.assay: Numbat-multiome: published scATAC alone, scRNA alone or separate same-sample modalities
methods.inputs: ATAC-bin: raw integer bin-by-cell fragment counts; bin-by-reference-type normalized ATAC matrix; genomic-bin GRanges; phased SNP-level allele-count table; parameter file. Official preparation uses aligned barcoded BAM, SNP VCF and Eagle2 reference panel.
methods.outputs: Allele-specific alteration states, posterior probabilities and clones
methods.mechanism: Published joint HMM models bin coverage with Poisson log-normal and phased allele counts with beta-binomial, 15 joint states; iterative clone-aware pooling.
methods.reference_requirements: ATAC-bin documented with normalized ATAC reference generated from normal cells; paper used healthy donor normal plasma or annotated normal cells. No suitable reference is known here; do not assume MCF10-A diploid.
methods.low_coverage_handling: Uses pooled SNPs and HMM; loss of informative heterozygotes and phase uncertainty restrict power. Paper removes unobserved bins before benchmark; missing-data behavior in all modes still requires code audit.
methods.homozygous_deletion: Explicit (0,0) candidate genotype in scRNA model; not proof that ATAC can resolve it
methods.evidence: Published scATAC ATAC-bin mode benchmarked against matched WGS in MM and CLL/RS tumor cohorts; average ~200 kb bins, bin sizes 50–500 kb examined; not validated here or in no-normal homogeneous samples.
